notice.ai.missingKey: AI edits need your {provider} API key. Add it in Settings, or turn AI edits off.
notice.ai.quota: Your {provider} account is out of credits.
notice.ai.rawInserted: Inserted the transcript without AI edits.
notice.command.droppedText: The result left out most of your text, so it wasn't pasted.
notice.command.failed: Command Mode didn't get a result ({error}). Nothing was changed.
notice.command.fieldTooLong: That field is too long for Command Mode. Select the text to change.
notice.command.selectionChanged: The selection changed, so the result is on the clipboard.
notice.command.tooLong: That text is too long for Command Mode (over {max} words). Select less text.
notice.dictation.recoverCancelled: You can recover your cancelled transcript
notice.dictation.interrupted: Dictation cancelled because another shortcut was pressed.
notice.language.detected: Speaking a different language? That sounded like {language}.
notice.mic.allow: Allow Shrimp to use the microphone, then dictate again.
notice.mic.bluetooth: Bluetooth microphones like {name} sound muffled and can be slow to start. A built-in or wired microphone works better.
notice.mic.muted: Is your microphone muted? Shrimp can't hear anything from {name}.
notice.mic.slowToOpen: {name} is taking a long time to open.
notice.mic.stillNoAudio: Still no audio from {name}. Is it muted or out of range?
notice.paste.elevated: Run Shrimp as administrator to insert text everywhere. Your transcript is on the clipboard.
notice.paste.needAccessibility: Shrimp needs Accessibility to paste. Your transcript is on the clipboard.
notice.paste.noTextField: No text field is focused. Your transcript is on the clipboard.
notice.setup.globeKey: Pressing fn also {conflict}. In System Settings › Keyboard, set “Press 🌐 key to” to Do Nothing.
notice.setup.lostAccessibility: Shrimp lost Accessibility access after the update. Grant it again to keep using your shortcuts and pasting.
notice.setup.lostMicrophone: Shrimp lost Microphone access after the update. Grant it again to keep dictating.
notice.setup.modelGettingReady: The speech model is getting ready. Try again in a moment.
notice.setup.recovered: Shrimp saved a dictation that was interrupted. Recover it in History.
notice.shortcuts.needAccessibility: Shrimp needs Accessibility permission for its shortcuts.
notice.shortcuts.secureInput: Secure Keyboard Entry is on (macOS names {app}), so shortcuts with letters or other keys are blocked until it's off. fn and other modifier-only shortcuts still work.
notice.stt.failedFellBack: Cloud transcription failed ({error}). Used Whisper on this Mac instead.
notice.stt.unavailableFellBack: {message} Used Whisper on this Mac instead.
notice.tip.backtrack: Tip: say “actually…” to correct yourself as you speak.
notice.tip.backtrackExplained: Shrimp kept only your correction. Say “actually”, “no wait” or “scratch that” to change what you just said.
notice.tip.email: Tip: in email apps, Shrimp lays out greetings and sign-offs.
notice.tip.emailExplained: Shrimp laid that out as an email: the greeting, the body and the sign-off each on their own lines.
notice.tip.holdForCommand: Hold {shortcut} while you speak a command, or double-press it for hands-free.
notice.tip.holdToDictate: Hold {shortcut} to dictate, or double-tap it for hands-free.
notice.tip.list: Tip: say “one… two…” to make a list.
notice.tip.listExplained: Shrimp made that a list. Say “one… two… three…” or “first… second…” and it formats the items for you.
notice.transform.autoFailed: {name} didn't run ({error}), so your dictation was pasted as it was.
notice.transform.noTextBox: Couldn't detect text in your text box
notice.transform.polishTooLong: Oops, too long to polish. Try again with under {max} words.
notice.transform.selectLess: Oops, too long to transform. Select less text.
notice.transform.selectText: Select text to apply a transform
notice.transform.textChanged: The text changed, so the result is on the clipboard.
notice.transform.tooLong: Oops, too long to transform. Try again with under {max} words.
notice.update.ready: Update ready, restart now? Shrimp {version} is downloaded.
notice.update.upToDate: You're up to date. Shrimp {version} is the latest version.
notice.update.waiting: Shrimp restarts to update when you finish dictating.
